reviews.text:
My pup was a mess, both physically and emotionally. She was matted on her undercarriage and had Verde River stuff stuck in her coat & feets.
She hates me grooming her. Im so lucky that Stephanie is so good with her. My pup now looks & smells one million times better - after this visit!

I came here years ago to get my Chihuahua's nails clipped. She absolutely despised getting her nails clipped and several groomers had tried and failed. Lucky Dog Spa was the only place that took the time and attention to get it done safely with no harm to my girl.

I've moved back to the area and now have a doodle and this was the first place I thought of for her grooming. Her puppy cut was excellent and she had a great time! Will definitely come back again!

Victoria is one of the most skilled and compassionate dog groomers I’ve ever encountered. She has an exceptional ability to keep my dog—who suffers from severe anxiety—calm and cooperative throughout the grooming process. Her work is consistently beautiful and precise, and my dog is always happy and relaxed when I pick him up. Victoria is punctual, efficient, and provides outstanding value to both pets and their owners. I would confidently recommend her to anyone seeking a professional, trustworthy, and highly talented groomer.
Stephanie does a great job with my nervous yorkie. She’s always timely and communicative
Lucky Dog takes great care of all 3 of our dogs.  Steph treats them like family.  We have recommended Lucky dog to our family members and friends
Mary did such a great job on Colby! Took the time to comb him out and make him look amazing!

Hello, this is an updated review, Teddy has been loyal customer to Stephanie since 2021, 3 years now; Teddy was 2 years old such a baby and now he's about to be 6 years old. Teddy loves Stephanie and trust me as an owner I struggled to find …
Stephanie at lucky dog spa was awesome! Greer communication and even better service - my pup has never looked (and smelled) better!
I’ve taken my pup Juno to Stephanie and I am always pleased with everything! Stephanie is very professional and Juno loves her!
